name: dandori (Linear-compatible issue planning)
description: Stdio MCP server for the dandori itonami dapp: imports and exports Linear CSV and GraphQL JSON, and computes cycle progress, estimate validity and SLA status with dandori rules. Pure tools over the passed data; sends and stores nothing.

DANDORI_REPO.description: Absolute path to a cloud-itonami/app-itonami-dandori checkout at the pinned commit. The launcher re-executes with this directory as cwd so kbb resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text from nbb.edn.
